title: Philippines, Slovakia sign deal to boost labor ties

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Philippines and Slovakia on Monday established a Labor Consultation Mechanism to strengthen bilateral labor cooperation, including coordination on employment opportunities, recruitment procedures and the recognition of worker credentials, according to the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW). The mechanism was established through a Joint Communiqué signed on Sept. 28 by the DMW, led by Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac, and the Ministry of Labour, Social Affairs and Family of the Slovak Republic, represented by Slovak Ambassador Miloš Koterec.
